_comment: Fresh install seeds this file as config.json. Track it only when it contains project settings and environment-variable references. Fill via ws-configure-project. toolsFile points to the tool vocabulary all agents use (managed runtime lives in the skills install).

pathTokens._comment: skillsRoot is fixed; sharedDir is the relocatable hub root (repo-relative, contained; bootstrap config stays at .ws/config.json). Expand brace tokens before Read/Grep/Shell. Full contract: {skillsRoot}/ws-shared/runtime/tools.md § Path tokens. plansDir/reviewsDir still resolve from plans.dir / reviews.dir.

stack.description: MCP stdio + CLI; Markdown records; SQLite FTS as disposable index

layers.name: mcp-cli
layers.role: Tool handlers, argument schemas, bootstrap budget

domain.model: Curated agent working memory outside product git (traps, decisions, specs, plans, logs)

providers._comment: active = work-item/spec source (github | azure-devops | local). scm = PR/thread host (github | azure-devops only; never local). Hybrid example: active=local + scm=github (local specs, GitHub PRs). If scm omitted: when active is github|azure-devops → scm=active; when active=local → infer from project.repoUrl host (github.com → github; dev.azure.com|visualstudio.com → azure-devops) or STOP and set scm explicitly. LEGACY: omit this entire providers block to infer active from issueTrackers.*.enabled (GitHub if enabled, else Azure DevOps, else local).

azureDevOps._comment: Set enabled: true and fill org/project. Put token in ADO_PAT (or AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT) — never commit it.

verification._comment_mutationThreshold: Minimum mutation score percent (killed/(killed+survived)*100). Used when mutationTest is set and skipMutationTesting is false.
verification._comment_localReviewCommand: Optional local review runner command (e.g. cursor-reviewer dry-run). When configured or detected, ws-code-review offers a pre-PR dry-run pass before Step 8 ship.
verification._comment_testGlobs: Machine test-surface probe patterns. Step 7 auto-skip requires no non-empty test alias and no matching file.

dagThresholds._comment: If ALL criteria are within limits, execMode is sequential (skip DAG).

defaults._comment_skipMutationTesting: When true (default), skip Step 7 mutation substep even if verification.mutationTest is set. Opt in by setting false and providing mutationTest.
defaults._comment_scoreAndRefine: Optional extra polish when Step 5 score is already >= minVerifyScore (default 9) (wide-context overengineering sweep; unused workflow-introduced artifact removal). Score below minVerifyScore always runs scoreAndRefine until the bar (max 3 rounds, then Pause).
defaults._comment_minVerifyScore: Integer 1-10. Advance / scoreAndRefine / post-review requiresFix bar. Omitted or invalid → 9. Score below this always runs scoreAndRefine until met (max 3 rounds, then Pause).
defaults._comment_autoload: When true, consumer intends repo-root AGENTS.md to autoload Always-applied skills from {sharedDir}/autoload.md. Omitted/missing/false → effective false; harness fails closed only when true.
defaults._comment_autoloadTaskLifecycle: When false, --write-autoload drops ws-task-lifecycle from the Always-applied table (opt-out). Omitted/true → required autoload. Does not set defaults.autoload.
defaults._comment_enableDag: When true, break execution plan into multiple parallel tasks. When false (default), execute tasks sequentially one by one in serial order.
defaults._comment_requirePreShipDocSync: When true (default), the pre-ship doc-sync trio (ws-wiki sync + ws-spec-index sync + changelog entry) is a gate-enforced close step in both orchestrators; the ship phase does not advance while a required leg is outstanding. The wiki leg warn-skips when no wiki is configured; index + changelog legs stay required. When false, both orchestrators keep today's behavior. Omitted or invalid values resolve to true.
defaults._comment_verboseMode: Seeded true by ws-configure-project / config.json.example. Runtime: explicit true prints a reasoned start-of-step preview; omitted or false → silent. Preview text is not canned in skills.
defaults._comment_branchStrategy: Default branch strategy for the workflow bootstrap feature-branch gate: stay (default, no gate on attached HEAD) | from-current | from-base | prompt (always gate). Detached HEAD rejects stay.
defaults._comment_enableOptionalProofOfWork: When true, the orchestrator presents one opt-in gate after the workflow reaches its finished state asking whether to start the evidence-collector workflow. Omitted or false (default): no gate; steps, gates, commits, telemetry, and artifacts match current behavior exactly.
defaults._comment_enableAutomaticEvidenceCollectF: When true together with enableOptionalProofOfWork, start the evidence collector without a gate. In autoMode this key alone decides auto-start versus silent skip; the post-completion step never blocks.
defaults._comment_projectRootFolderToSave: Evidence output folder for the post-completion proof-of-work step. Supports {projectRoot} and {slug} tokens. The evidence folder is never committed unless separately asked.
defaults._comment_contextBudget: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in one complete standard subagent dispatch; fixed contract preamble remains capped at 18000 and MEMORY at 4000.
defaults._comment_parallelVerifyReview: When true, standard Steps 5 and 6 may run concurrently as read-only reviewers after an immutable product commit; default false.
defaults._comment_gateGranularity: step prompts at every boundary; phase uses at most five blocking gates in a normal standard run without weakening hard stops.
defaults._comment_providerCompat: Optional host hints only. Skill bodies never hardcode vendor HTTP flags. thinkingToolCompat default false; stabilizeStaticPrefix default true.
defaults._comment_contextHygiene: pruneAfterStep default true: next step reads the prior state.handoffs entry. backgroundVerboseSteps default false; unsupported hosts log background-unsupported and block.
defaults._comment_reviewJury: Integer 1-3. Default 1 (single reviewer). Size 2-3 is standard Step 6 only; lite ignores and records juryIgnored: lite-inline.
defaults._comment_hostAdapter: Optional. Skills call portable dispatch-agent / browser-mcp. mode auto|native-tool|cli-command|inline-isolated or a named host mapping from host-dispatch.md.
defaults._comment_specializedSubagents: Optional opt-in. When enabled: true, compile_host_subagents.cjs materializes host-native projections (one directory per dialect; neutral generic fallback) with pre-baked skill prompts. directory may be 'projectLevel' (dynamically resolved relative to project) or 'userLevel' ($HOME/.cursor/agents, etc). Compiled files carry @generated signatures: commit per team policy or gitignore; recompile after skill updates (--check in CI).
defaults._comment_deliveryCommitArtifacts: Step 8 delivery commit includes under {us-dir}. Defaults: refined plan on; delivery result off (behavior change vs legacy always plan+result); opt-ins false. Omitted object/keys at read time merge to these AC1 defaults — never silently revert to always staging plan+result.
defaults._comment_models: Resolve order when --model is blank: stepModels[role|N] → active preset steps[role|N] → top-level phase key → preset phase key → session. Token "current" uses session currentModel (no fallthrough). Empty string falls through. Unknown modelsPreset → preset "default" if present, else legacy four keys. Fix-PR roles bypass numeric Step 9: fixPrPlan → reviewerModel; fixPrExec → executionModel. Lite ignores testingModel and all role keys, including fixPrPlan/fixPrExec, while preserving inline plan-before-edit order. Presets are lean phase-key bundles without a steps map; put per-step or per-role overrides in top-level stepModels. The default preset is all current (session-only safe fallback). Switch modelsPreset to a named bundle (cursor, deepseek, opencode, cheap, muse-spark) for host-specific models.
defaults._comment_stepModels: Optional project-wide overrides (win over the active preset). Empty string = fall through. Keys 0-9 are standard steps; lite uses 0-5. Roles: dag, scoreAndRefine, reviewFix, fixPrPlan, fixPrExec. Fix-PR roles never inherit numeric 9.
defaults._comment_stepRunners: Optional step-level baton run config: step number to runner id. Unmapped steps keep single-host dispatch. Runner ids are opaque neutral strings.

plans._comment_plansDir: Resolve skill token {plansDir} from plans.dir (there is no separate plansDir key).
plans._comment_specsDir: Human-facing local specs dir. Skill token {specsDir} ← plans.specsDir (default .agents/specs). Prefer existing repo-root specs/ when already present. ws-spec-write writes here only; workflow step-00 copies under {plansDir}/{slug}/ come from providers or ws-spec-provider-local register.
plans._comment_wikiDir: Living feature wiki and domain knowledge base root. Skill token {wikiDir} ← plans.wikiDir (default .agents/specs/wiki).
plans._comment_wiki: Living wiki defaults. plans.wiki.verbosity selects ws-wiki prose style (condensed default terse; detailed paragraph walkthrough).
plans._comment_enforceSpecPrefixOrdering: When true, new spec-of-record writes and organizer apply NNNN-{slug}.spec.md under {specsDir}. Omitted, non-boolean, or missing config safely resolves to false. ws-spec-write persists this exact key when it is absent (seed true if the board already uses NNNN- files).
plans._comment_statusSubfolders: When true, new specs resolve under {specsDir}/pending/ and the organizer files specs into pending/, completed/, archived/ by status. Default false keeps flat boards.

reviews._comment: Optional local review artifact root (fix-pr / ws-goal-fix-pr round reports).

preview._comment: Optional. /ws-preview runs preview.dryRunCommand from the consumer repo root — no packaged reviewer backend. Prefer /ws-configure-project --section preview (infers from AGENTS.md, README, MEMORY, rules.*, package.json scripts, and local skills) or set the string below. Empty → /ws-preview stops until configured.
preview._comment_dryRunCommand: Examples: npm run review:dry | bash scripts/pipeline-review-dry-run.sh | node tools/local-review-dry-run.cjs
preview._comment_previewBeforeShip: When true (default if omitted), ws-ship-pr runs the dry-run once after commit/push and before Create PR; failures are reported, shipping continues. Explicit false disables the gate.

rules._comment: Guardrails paths. Resolve per ws-shared/AGENTS.md External dependencies (first match). harness default is the project-local {sharedDir}/AGENTS.md (default .ws/AGENTS.md; scoped to the configured hub on seed/upgrade); on global-hybrid installs resolve via the {globalSkillsRoot} fallback (config-resolution.md Harness entrypoint fallback); installer seeds a thin local pointer when missing. seniorDeveloper = Delivery gate and surgical diffs (default packaged ws-senior-developer); set "" to disable or point at another guardrail; karpathyGuidelines = compatibility alias pointing to ws-senior-developer; stackFile = stack companion; changelogFile = append-only history (default repo-root CHANGELOG.md; legacy .ws/CHANGELOG.md used only when it holds entries and the configured file does not); memoryDir = local memory target dir holding MEMORY.md + memory/ (default repo root "."; same legacy fallback); other keys optional consumer rule paths — leave empty when unused.

tracking._comment: ws-task-lifecycle Completion walk. featuresMdEnabled default true when omitted; set false to disable the features file entirely. autoTrackSpecWrite default true when omitted; standalone spec-write auto-tracks to index.PRD (no gate); false skips. Absent or empty canonicalFiles → auto-detected features file (repo-root FEATURES.md when it exists, else {specsDir}/index.PRD), PLAN.md, PRODUCT.PRD.

monitor._comment: Opt-in ws-monitor host transcript discovery (us-356). discoverHostTranscripts default false (zero host-store reads); hostHome overrides the home used for discovery/sanitizing (CI/sandbox); transcriptRoots adds explicit roots.

specMemo._comment: External spec-memo vault bridge (ws-spec-memo). enableSpecMemoIntegration: true routes memory/traps to memo MCP/CLI. enableMemoryFiles: true routes memory to local memory/*.md and MEMORY.md. Both can be true (dual-mode) or false (disabled). When boolean flags are absent, resolveMemoryRouting derives them from specMemo.mode (local|vault|hybrid|disabled); explicit flags always win. Legacy enabled without mode still resolves.

fable._comment: Opt-in integration for fable-* skills within ws-spec-to-pr / ws-spec-to-pr-lite workflows. Master toggle must be true to enable automatic calls.

ws-goal-fix-pr._comment: Per-skill section for the fix-PR convergence loop (seeds the one-parent-section-per-skill convention). useSubAgents false (default when omitted) runs the plan/fix loop inline in the current turn with zero subagent dispatches; true dispatches one fresh worker per round batch. One key gates the whole fix path (ws-fix-pr, ws-goal-fix-pr, ws-ship-pr pre-ship convergence).

ws-spec-translate-to-human._comment: Per-skill section for the human-companion generator (ws-spec-translate-to-human, refinement hook in ws-plan-write). enabled false skips companion generation; outputLanguage selects the companion language (en-us default, pt-BR supported). Generation is non-blocking either way.
